captions.detailed: This 3D model features a medical exam-room lamp mounted on a ceiling-articulated arm. It consists of a flat square ceiling plate, a vertical shoulder cylinder, a two-part articulated arm with an upper arm and forearm connected by a cylindrical elbow joint, and a round lamp head. The lamp head is held in a U-shaped yoke. The joints allow for multi-axis rotation, including a shoulder pan, an elbow pitch, a forearm pan, and a lamp head tilt within the yoke.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a medical exam-room lamp with a ceiling-mounted articulated arm. The assembly should include a flat square ceiling plate, a two-link arm (upper arm and forearm) connected by revolute joints, and a circular lamp head supported by a U-shaped yoke that allows both panning and tilting. Use neutral gray and beige materials for the metal and plastic components.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by defining several links and joints. It starts with a base link consisting of a thin Box for the ceiling plate, a Cylinder shoulder, and a lower conical base. The upper arm is built from dual parallel cylinders connected to a central cylindrical elbow joint. The forearm is modeled using longitudinal cylinders and a central sliding track. The lamp yoke is constructed using a horizontal Box and vertical side brackets, which finally connect to the circular lamp head modeled with a cylindrical housing, a spherical back cap, and a flat circular lens.
